postAttachCommand.next-steps:
printf '
\033[1;32m✅ Setup complete.\033[0m
Dev server is starting on port 3000.

When you see "Ready in ...", do this:
  1. Open the \033[1mPorts\033[0m tab (next to Terminal)
  2. Right-click port \033[1m3000\033[0m → Port Visibility → \033[1mPublic\033[0m
  3. Copy the forwarded URL and open it on your phone.

DEMO_MODE is on by default. To use real Claude, set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
as a Codespace secret and remove DEMO_MODE from .devcontainer/devcontainer.json.

'
